android.desc:
Paint Launcher is your home screen without the icons. Upload your wallpaper and paint where you want to tap to launch a certain app. Your phone has never been so beautiful and less distracting. 

Instructions:
Hold the screen to open the editor. You can click the wallpaper button to add a wallpaper image and size it to your screen. Click the plus icon to add your first swatch. Then, choose the app and color you want to represent it.
After the swatch is added, you can click it and use it to paint a tap zone on your wallpaper.

After this is saved, you will be able to launch an app by tapping on the places on your wallpaper where you painted it.
You can swipe up on the launcher to open the app drawer which will allow you to quickly search and launch any app.
Swiping down on the home screen to expand your notifications/status bar.

quotes.text:
I'm working on Paint Launcher (beta) – a minimalist Android home screen without icons, where you paint tappable zones onto your wallpaper instead. You can try it out now here:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lukew3.paintlauncher
